Prepare a small tray of paper shapes before starting the fictional exercise.
The insert below supplies the sorting procedure.

\markdownInput{inputs/sorting-notes.md}

\begin{fieldpanel}
Keep the folded pieces beside the flat pieces until the count is complete.
The comparison weight is \(\frac{5}{\sqrt{q}}\), so record the denominator
as well as the count.

\underline{\href{https://example.org/field-guide}{Read the field guide}}
\end{fieldpanel}

After the insert and reminder, return every piece to the tray.
